entry.title: New: dsh-elf
entry.summary: Floating translucent DeepSeek whale elf on the DSH page that opens a draggable, minimizable temporary chat window using the session model or a custom OpenAI-compatible endpoint, with real-time streaming. Exact install spec: github:winditer/dsh-elf. Source event: awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin; changed: listed.
